title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Netflix highlights for August 2026 include classic films like 'Clueless' and newer features like Bo Burnham's 'Eighth Grade'.
New releases to watch this weekend on streaming: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' on Paramount+ and 'You, Me & Tuscany' on Peacock.
Boston.com staff picks feature 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' on Paramount+ and 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 on Apple TV.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an eight-foot Bigfoot sighting on July 5 in Voluntown, Connecticut, verified by BFRO.
Since 1994, 126 credible Bigfoot sightings have been reported in New England, according to the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
Boston University professor doubts Bigfoot's existence due to lack of scientific evidence and DNA samples.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, advice columnist and daughter of Ann Landers, passed away last month at age 86.
Howard was known for her practical, empathetic advice, writing columns such as Dear Prudence and Dear Margo.
Meredith Goldstein reflects on Howard's influence, highlighting her approach to grief and personal growth.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox pitcher Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters in a 13-1 win over the Athletics.
Boston Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games with a decisive victory featuring 15 hits.
Red Sox newcomer Raymond Burgos pitched three innings without allowing a hit or walk in his debut.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are facing off at Patriots training camp, exchanging competitive trash talk and challenging each other.
Gonzalez, preparing for a tough 2026 receiver slate, uses Brown matchups to enhance his skills against top NFL receivers.
Despite contract negotiations, Gonzalez actively participates in training camp, while Brown aims to bounce back after a down season.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman will start a rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester Red Sox on Saturday.
Rutschman was placed on the injured list by the Orioles due to left wrist inflammation.
Red Sox traded three prospects and Carlos Narvaez for Rutschman, aiming to boost their playoff run.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' is available on Paramount+, continuing Aang's journey with an ancient warrior awakening.
'The Ballad of Wallis Island', a comedy-drama starring Tim Key, is streaming on Peacock.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4, featuring Jason Sudeikis coaching a women's team, is streaming on Apple TV.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet may return to the Red Sox bullpen in 2026 amid ongoing recovery from shoulder and lat injuries.
Interim manager Chad Tracy expressed doubts about Crochet returning as a starter, favoring a bullpen role instead.
Crochet is open to relieving and awaits the team's decision regarding his role upon return this season.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named 'Tippy' was found near Ellington Street in Dorchester, left in a cage in a community garden.
Residents reported the snake to Animal Care and Control, who transported it to their facility in Roslindale.
Boston Animal Care and Control is seeking information from anyone who may be missing the python.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 victory over Team White, completing 13-of-16 passes with two touchdowns.
DeMario Douglas excelled for Team Blue with six catches, including a 50-yard touchdown, showcasing his versatility during the scrimmage.
Injury updates: Will Campbell expected back after the weekend; Carlton Davis likely out until next week, missing preseason opener.
